description: This Police1 article (Nov. 6, 2025, by Terrence P. Dwyer, Esq.) analyzes qualitative comments from 184 respondents to a Police1 survey of female law enforcement officers about workplace sexual harassment, discrimination, and agency culture. According to the survey, 77% of respondents reported experiencing sexual harassment, while fewer than one in four incidents were reported to their agencies. The article is a commentary on survey findings and does not itself document a specific filed civil lawsuit. The only individual lawsuit it references is Detective Carryn Barker's suit against San Mateo County, which is captured separately in this database as record san-mateo-r10.
